entries.reason: React Router: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass Allows Action Execution Before 400 Response. This app does not use React Server Components (RSC) or SSR — it's a client-only SPA (see vite.config.js / no server entry) — so this attack surface does not apply. The only fix is `npm audit fix --force`, which downgrades react-router-dom to 7.11.0 (a breaking change).
